regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate current-work claim were reviewed. The page states online SI availability, but source_mapping.json marks SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 center-right Scheme 1
regions.finding: Generic selectivity challenge enumerating eight possible regio-/stereoisomers from a multisubstituted allene; classified as a general scheme, not as eight experiments.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and prior-work discussion continuing to page 2
regions.finding: Prior copper borylations/hydroborations are cited literature. The explicitly depicted Scheme 2a-c condition sets are classified as literature examples on page 2; no cited result is mislabeled as a current-paper experiment.

unresolved: The generic Scheme 1 R groups do not define unique structures or experiments.
Most cited literature in the introduction lacks complete restated conditions and was not expanded beyond the explicitly depicted Scheme 2 examples.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 2 panels a-d
regions.finding: Four prior-work arrows were classified as literature examples (Santos; two condition-selective arrows from the authors' earlier work; Hoveyda) and panel d as a generic current-work overview. Aggregate ranges/selectivities were not converted into current-paper substrate rows.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1-9, and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Nine independent optimization experiments retained with base/ligand/time, NMR yield, recovered 1a in entries 4-5, and the 5 mol% K2CO3 override in entry 9. Entry 1 retains the explicit 0% failed product outcome.

regions.region: page 2 Results and Discussion prose surrounding Tables 1-2 and Scheme 3
regions.finding: Narrative optimization and scope statements were linked to the corresponding Table 1/Table 2/Scheme 3 records rather than duplicated; one-gram 1d is kept separate from the small-scale 1d row.

unresolved: Table 1 omits absolute quantities, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Compact substrate/product structures and stereochemistry remain machine candidates or source labels.
No SI file was supplied or explicitly associated.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 2 reaction drawing, entries 1-15, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Fifteen distinct scope experiments retained row-by-row with shared quantities/conditions, row times and yields; entry 5 is the separate one-gram run, entry 14 is a 54% NMR yield with Z/E 83:17, and entry 15 replaces Et2O with THF.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 3 and Figure 1
regions.finding: Five 4,4-disubstituted allenamide arrows retained separately. Figure 1 is an ORTEP structure of Z-2q supporting Scheme 3's 1q row and is not an additional reaction.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Equation (1)
regions.finding: The 1s to 2s borylcupration is retained as a distinct 2 h/87% substrate-scope experiment.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Scheme 4
regions.finding: Two distinct amide-free control substrates each gave a mixture with poor regioselectivity; both negative-selectivity experiments are retained without invented yields or product identities.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right prose introducing Schemes 5-6 and DFT study
regions.finding: Four downstream transformations and three isotope/proton-source controls continue as explicit arrows on page 4 and are linked to those records. The DFT discussion is classified separately from observed experiments.

unresolved: Scheme 3 and Eq. (1) omit scale, workup, purification, masses, and yield bases.
Scheme 4 mixture compositions and yields are not reported.
Compact structures and ORTEP-supported stereochemistry remain machine-unverified.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Scheme 5
regions.finding: Four independent transformations of Z-2d retained: CuCl2 chlorination (90%), CuBr2 bromination (81%), H2O2/NaOH hydroxylation to 5 (81%), and Pd-catalyzed PhI coupling to 6 (96%). All printed footnote-like reagent loadings/concentrations are participants, not notes only.

regions.region: page 4 center-left Scheme 6
regions.finding: Three control experiments retained separately: 1n/iPrOD to 2n-d, 1t/iPrOH to 2t, and 1t/iPrOD to 2t-d. The 94% scheme versus 96% prose yield discrepancy for 2n-d is preserved, with 50% allylic and 46% nitrogen deuterium incorporation; 2t-d has 84% allylic incorporation.

regions.region: page 4 lower half Figure 2 and accompanying DFT text
regions.finding: Calculated pathway/energy profile through 1A/1B, TS1A/TS1B, and 2A/2B is classified as computational mechanism evidence, not a preparative reaction. Energy values with unsupported compound units are retained in notes.

unresolved: Schemes 5-6 omit scale, absolute solvent/reagent quantities, workup, purification, masses, and most analytical bases.
The 2n-d scheme/prose yield conflict is unresolved.
Computational intermediates and transition states are proposed/calculated rather than isolated.

regions.region: page 5 upper Figure 3 and stereoselectivity discussion
regions.finding: Two calculated insertion transition states TS1A_Z and TS1A_E and their 3.8 kcal mol−1 difference are computational support, not separate experiments.

regions.region: page 5 center-right Scheme 7
regions.finding: Explicitly proposed catalytic cycle through copper-boryl addition, copper migration, and iPrOH protonolysis; classified with Figures 2-3 as one mechanism record, not observed preparation steps.

regions.region: page 5 Conclusion
regions.finding: Conclusion summarizes the borylcupration scope and selectivity without adding a new experiment-specific arrow or outcome.

unresolved: The computational model differs from the full experimental catalyst/substrates; complete computational details are outside the structured reaction records.
No new preparative experiment is printed on this page.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left General methods and typical Z-2a procedure
regions.finding: Argon/oven-dried Schlenk conditions, exact quantities, 2 h/TLC, silica filtration, 10:1 chromatography, 176.6 mg, and 94% isolated yield were merged into Table 2 entry 1 rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 6 left/right detailed preparations Z-2b through Z-2d
regions.finding: Exact reagent/substrate quantities, product masses, and chromatography for Table 2 entries 2-4 were merged into those rows. The small-scale Z-2d preparation remains distinct from the following one-gram experiment.

regions.region: page 6 right-column one-gram Z-2d preparation
regions.finding: The 3.68 mmol 1d run with 4.42 mmol B2(pin)2, 10 mL Et2O, 1.2731 g Z-2d, and 86% yield was merged into Table 2 entry 5 and not combined with entry 4.

regions.region: page 6 right-column detailed preparations Z-2e through Z-2g
regions.finding: Exact quantities, product masses, and 10:1 or 15:1 chromatography for Table 2 entries 6-8 were merged into their corresponding table rows. Spectral text was treated as characterization, not additional experiments.

unresolved: For preparations Z-2b through Z-2g, purification is stated but a separate pre-chromatography workup is not restated.
iPrOH density uses the unsupported compound unit g mL−1 and is preserved in notes; volume, mass, and amount are structured.
Characterization and parseability do not establish structure correctness; structures remain unverified.
